author: Matt Wolfe
description:
🚨 The creator of OpenClaw, Peter Steinberger, has officially joined OpenAI. 

It’s a a crazy story: Anthropic’s legal pressure accidentally pushed the biggest AI agent developer right into the arms of their biggest rival. 

I have a full video breaking down the full timeline, the security disasters, and what this means for the future of AI agents. 

#OpenAI #Anthropic #OpenClaw #AI #AInews
title: Anthropic Fumbled the Bag On This One...

author: Matt Wolfe
description:
OpenAI just dropped GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark that's supposed to be just as good as Codex but faster.  

Thanks to a partnership with Cerebras (the chip makers), this model is optimized to build quickly. 

I tested it live with a "Vampire Survivors" style prompt and in under a minute, I had a playable game called "Nocturne Survivors" with functioning XP, leveling, and upgrade systems.

But right now it's only on the $200/mo Pro plan.

#AI #AInews #openai #chatgpt #vibecoding
title: Is The New OpenAI Model Actually THAT Fast?
